title: Schedule View OFF hides top nav Schedule item
role_used: ZZAUTOTEST custom role as Tech (workOrdersView only, scheduleView OFF)
expected: No Schedule item in top nav when scheduleView OFF
actual: With scheduleView OFF (workOrdersView-only role), top nav shows only Work Orders + notifications; no Schedule item/link present
reason: Schedule nav hidden when scheduleView off

title: Schedule View grants calendar access (shows all technicians)
role_used: ZZAUTOTEST custom role as Tech (scheduleView only)
expected: Schedule page loads; appointments for ALL technicians visible; no create/edit/delete affordances
actual: With scheduleView only, 'Schedule' shows in top nav and /schedule loads a full calendar rendering 162 appointment/event elements spanning many work orders and customers (S9-24xxx..S9-25xxx, multiple customers) - clearly all users' appointments, not just the logged-in user's. No create/new-appointment affordance was present (only the nav item)
reason: Calendar access granted, all appointments visible, read-only (no create affordance) as expected

title: Schedule Create and Edit enables create / modify / drag-and-drop
role_used: ZZAUTOTEST custom role as Tech (scheduleView + scheduleCreateAndEdit)
expected: Create new appointment, assign technician, drag to new slot, and save all succeed
actual: scheduleCreateAndEdit permission is effective (present in fe-permissions), but schedule creation is a click-to-create/drag interaction on the calendar grid with no persistent create button; the automation harness could not reliably click a calendar cell or perform drag-and-drop to exercise create/modify/save
reason: Interactive create/modify/drag-drop flow could not be driven via the harness; needs manual verification

title: Schedule Delete enables removing appointments
role_used: ZZAUTOTEST custom role as Tech (scheduleView + scheduleCreateAndEdit + scheduleDelete)
expected: Locate a test appointment, delete it, confirm, appointment removed
actual: Deleting an appointment requires opening an appointment and using an in-calendar delete action; this interactive flow (and creating a disposable test appointment first) could not be reliably driven via the harness
reason: Interactive delete flow could not be exercised via the harness; needs manual verification

title: Schedule Create and Edit only role opens Assign existing work order dialog and unscheduled WO list loads
role_used: ZZAUTOTEST custom role as Tech (scheduleView + scheduleCreateAndEdit)
expected: Assign existing work order dialog opens and the unscheduled-WO select renders options
actual: Could not trigger the Assign-existing-work-order dialog: it opens from clicking a day-resource calendar cell (no persistent button), which the harness could not reliably click; the precondition also requires WO view-mode OFF and a default workplace + a guaranteed unscheduled WO which could not be fully staged
reason: Assign dialog is click-to-open on a resource cell and could not be driven; needs manual verification
